title: Polar-Orbiting Satellite Imagery
description: Polar-orbiting satellite imagery from the JPSS (Joint Polar Satellite System) and MetOp satellite series, stored in Icechunk format. Data was converted from original instrument output using Satpy and covers weather, climate, and environmental observation use cases. The archive is continually expanding but is noted as incomplete.
